criteria.rationale: The patient was 42 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The request is for Wegovy for chronic weight management, and the prescribing note identifies obesity as the treatment indication.
Within 180 days of the request, the dietitian documented a reduced-calorie diet and swimming or water aerobics, then documented adherence and instructed the patient to continue the plan.

The May 20 initial nutrition consult explicitly states this was the patient's first formal counseling and that he had no prior structured diet or exercise plan. Although the August note describes eight months of personal efforts, documented structured counseling and follow-up began less than six months before the request.
The latest structured BMI before the request was 35.5 kg/m², meeting the BMI ≥30 threshold without needing a comorbidity.
